ui.name: UI Components
ui.description: Core building blocks - buttons, forms, cards, dialogs

form.name: Form
form.description: Form input components - buttons, inputs, selects

data-display.name: Data Display
data-display.description: Components for displaying data - cards, badges, tables

feedback.name: Feedback
feedback.description: User feedback components - alerts, toasts, tooltips

primitives.name: Primitives
primitives.description: Fundamental components used across the system

layout.name: Layout Components
layout.description: Page structure components - header, footer, navigation

button.name: Button
button.description: Button or button-styled link with variants, sizes, loading state and optional leading/trailing icons.
useInstead: Use Button with href for links styled as buttons, not a styled <a>; external URLs get target="_blank" and rel automatically.
Use icon (with size) for square icon-only buttons, and give them an aria-label.
Use the link variant for inline text actions, not a plain <button> with custom classes.
button.example:
---
import Button from '@/components/ui/form/Button/Button.astro';
---

<Button variant="primary" size="lg" trailingIcon="arrow-right" href="/contact">Get in touch</Button>
<Button variant="outline" type="submit" loading>Saving</Button>

input.name: Input
input.description: Text input with built-in label, hint, error message and optional leading/trailing icons.
useInstead: Use Input with label/hint/error instead of wrapping it in FormField; it already wires ids and aria-describedby.
Use PasswordInput for passwords and SearchInput for search fields.
input.example:
---
import Input from '@/components/ui/form/Input/Input.astro';
---

<Input name="email" type="email" label="Email" hint="We never share it." leadingIcon="mail" required />

textarea.name: Textarea
textarea.description: Multi-line text field with built-in label, hint and error message.
textarea.example:
---
import Textarea from '@/components/ui/form/Textarea/Textarea.astro';
---

<Textarea name="message" label="Message" rows={6} error="Please enter a message." />

select.name: Select
select.description: Native <select> built from an options array, with label, placeholder, hint and error.
useInstead: Use Dropdown for a menu of actions or links; Select is for choosing a form value.
select.example:
---
import Select from '@/components/ui/form/Select/Select.astro';
---

<Select
  name="plan"
  label="Plan"
  placeholder="Choose a plan"
  options={[
    { value: 'starter', label: 'Starter' },
    { value: 'pro', label: 'Pro' },
  ]}
/>

checkbox.name: Checkbox
checkbox.description: Native checkbox with label, optional description and error message.
useInstead: Use Switch for settings that take effect immediately (on/off), Checkbox for form choices and consent.
checkbox.example:
---
import Checkbox from '@/components/ui/form/Checkbox/Checkbox.astro';
---

<Checkbox name="terms" label="I agree to the terms" description="You can unsubscribe at any time." required />

radio.name: Radio
radio.description: Single native radio input with label and description; give a group the same name. The card variant renders a selectable card.
radio.example:
---
import Radio from '@/components/ui/form/Radio/Radio.astro';
---

<fieldset class="space-y-3">
  <legend class="text-sm font-medium">Billing</legend>
  <Radio name="billing" value="monthly" label="Monthly" checked />
  <Radio name="billing" value="yearly" label="Yearly" description="Two months free" variant="card" />
</fieldset>

switch.name: Switch
switch.description: Accessible on/off toggle (a checkbox with role="switch") with label and description.
useInstead: Use Checkbox for agreeing to terms or picking several options in a form.
switch.example:
---
import Switch from '@/components/ui/form/Switch/Switch.astro';
---

<Switch name="updates" label="Product updates" description="One email a month." checked />

card.name: Card
card.description: Surface container with variants and padding; becomes a block link when given href.
useInstead: Use Card with href for a clickable card, not a Card wrapped in <a>.
Use StatCard for a metric with a trend, and Section for page-level bands.
card.example:
--- import Card from '@/components/ui/data-display/Card/Card.astro'; ---

Read the blog

Guides and release notes.

badge.name: Badge
badge.description: Small inline label for status, tags or counts, with semantic color variants, a pill style and a pulsing dot.
useInstead: Use Badge for status and tags instead of a styled <span>; it is a <span>, so it can sit inside text.
badge.example:
---
import Badge from '@/components/ui/data-display/Badge/Badge.astro';
---

<Badge variant="success" size="sm">Live</Badge>
<Badge variant="brand" pill pulse>New release</Badge>

avatar.name: Avatar
avatar.description: Circular user image that falls back to initials (from fallback or alt) when there is no src.
useInstead: Use AvatarGroup for a stacked row of avatars with a "+N" overflow.
avatar.example:
---
import Avatar from '@/components/ui/data-display/Avatar/Avatar.astro';
---

<Avatar src="/avatars/ada.jpg" alt="Ada Lovelace" size="lg" />
<Avatar fallback="GH" size="sm" />

avatar-group.name: AvatarGroup
avatar-group.description: Overlapping stack of Avatars that collapses extras into a "+N" count.
useInstead: Use SocialProof for avatars next to a short trust line on marketing pages.

table.name: Table
table.description: Responsive data table rendered from columns and rows arrays, with hover, striped and compact options.
useInstead: Cells render as plain text; for rich cell content write a <table> with the same semantic classes.

pagination.name: Pagination
pagination.description: Page navigation (<nav>) with previous/next links and a window of numbered pages built from baseUrl.
pagination.example:
---
import Pagination from '@/components/ui/data-display/Pagination/Pagination.astro';
---

<Pagination currentPage={2} totalPages={8} baseUrl="/blog/page/" />

progress.name: Progress
progress.description: Progress bar with semantic color variants and optional percentage label; omit value for an indeterminate bar.
useInstead: Use Skeleton for loading placeholders that mimic content shape.
progress.example:
---
import Progress from '@/components/ui/data-display/Progress/Progress.astro';
---

<Progress value={64} variant="brand" showLabel aria-label="Upload progress" />

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.description: Animated placeholder block, circle or text line for content that is still loading.
skeleton.example: --- import Skeleton from '@/components/ui/data-display/Skeleton/Skeleton.astro'; ---

alert.name: Alert
alert.description: Inline message box (info, success, warning, error) with an icon, optional title and dismiss button.
useInstead: Use Toast for transient notifications triggered from a React island; Alert is static, in-page content.
alert.example:
---
import Alert from '@/components/ui/feedback/Alert/Alert.astro';
---

<Alert variant="warning" title="Scheduled maintenance" dismissible>
  The dashboard is read-only on Sunday from 02:00 to 04:00 UTC.
</Alert>

toast.name: Toast
toast.description: React toast notifications: ToastProvider renders the stack and useToast() returns toast()/dismiss(). Toast.astro mounts the provider as an island around its slot.
useInstead: Trigger toasts from a React component rendered inside ToastProvider in the same island; Astro islands passed into Toast.astro's slot hydrate separately and cannot reach its context.
Use Alert for static, in-page messages.

tooltip.name: Tooltip
tooltip.description: Text tooltip shown on hover and focus around a trigger passed in the default slot.
useInstead: Tooltips are supplementary: icon-only triggers still need their own aria-label. Use Dropdown or Dialog for interactive content.
tooltip.example:
---
import Tooltip from '@/components/ui/feedback/Tooltip/Tooltip.astro';
import Button from '@/components/ui/form/Button/Button.astro';
---

<Tooltip content="Copy to clipboard" position="bottom">
  <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" icon leadingIcon="copy" aria-label="Copy" />
</Tooltip>

dialog.name: Dialog
dialog.description: Accessible modal with focus trap, Escape/backdrop close, title, description and a footer slot. Open it with window.openDialog(id).
useInstead: Inline onclick is blocked by the CSP: open dialogs from a bundled <script> calling window.openDialog(id). Elements with data-dialog-close inside the dialog close it.
Use Tooltip for hints and Alert for in-page messages; reserve Dialog for tasks that need focus.
dialog.example:
--- import Dialog from '@/components/ui/overlay/Dialog/Dialog.astro'; import Button from '@/components/ui/form/Button/Button.astro'; ---

All deployments will be removed.

dropdown.name: Dropdown
dropdown.description: Menu of links or actions (with icons, separators and disabled items) opened from a trigger slot, with keyboard support.
useInstead: Use Select for picking a form value.
dropdown.example:
---
import Dropdown from '@/components/ui/overlay/Dropdown/Dropdown.astro';
import Button from '@/components/ui/form/Button/Button.astro';
---

<Dropdown
  align="end"
  items={[
    { label: 'Edit', href: '/settings', icon: 'edit' },
    { label: '', separator: true },
    { label: 'Archive', href: '/archive', icon: 'archive', disabled: true },
  ]}
>
  <Button slot="trigger" variant="outline" trailingIcon="chevron-down">Actions</Button>
</Dropdown>

tabs.name: Tabs
tabs.description: Horizontal tabs with keyboard navigation; panels are children marked data-tab-content="<tab id>".
useInstead: Use VerticalTabs for settings-style navigation with descriptions and icons, and Accordion for long stacked content.
tabs.example:
--- import Tabs from '@/components/ui/overlay/Tabs/Tabs.astro'; ---
Overview content
Pricing content

vertical-tabs.name: VerticalTabs
vertical-tabs.description: Side-list tabs with optional descriptions and icons that turn into a dropdown or bottom sheet on mobile; panels use data-tab-content.
vertical-tabs.example:
--- import VerticalTabs from '@/components/ui/overlay/VerticalTabs/VerticalTabs.astro'; ---
Account settings
Security settings

accordion.name: Accordion
accordion.description: Collapsible sections built on native <details>/<summary> (works without JS), with an exclusive single-open mode.
useInstead: Item content is plain text; for rich content per item use native <details> with the same classes, or Tabs.
accordion.example:
---
import Accordion from '@/components/ui/overlay/Accordion/Accordion.astro';
---

<Accordion
  variant="card"
  exclusive
  items={[
    { title: 'Is it free?', content: 'Yes, Velocity is MIT licensed.', defaultOpen: true },
    { title: 'Can I use React?', content: 'Yes, as islands.' },
  ]}
/>

separator.name: Separator
separator.description: Horizontal or vertical divider line, optionally with a centered label.
useInstead: Use Separator instead of a bare <hr> or bordered <div>.
separator.example:
--- import Separator from '@/components/ui/layout/Separator/Separator.astro'; ---
Docs Blog

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Inline SVG icon from a built-in set of Lucide paths (plus a few brand icons), sized by preset.
useInstead: Use the leadingIcon/trailingIcon props of Button and Input instead of placing Icon inside them by hand.
Only the names under Icon names exist; add a path to the icons map in Icon.astro for new ones, rather than importing an icon library.
icon.example:
---
import Icon from '@/components/ui/primitives/Icon/Icon.astro';
---

<Icon name="check-circle" size="sm" class="text-success" />

code-block.name: CodeBlock
code-block.description: Static code display with a window header, optional filename, line numbers and a copy button.
useInstead: In Markdown/MDX content, use fenced code blocks; CodeBlock is for code shown in .astro pages.
code-block.example:
---
import CodeBlock from '@/components/ui/content/CodeBlock/CodeBlock.astro';
---

<CodeBlock filename="astro.config.mjs" code={`export default defineConfig({\n  site: 'https://example.com',\n});`} />

logo.name: Logo
logo.description: The site's logo, rendered inline from the SVGs in src/assets/branding/ (logomark or full), with light/dark versions.
useInstead: Replace the SVG files in src/assets/branding/ to rebrand; do not hardcode an logo.
logo.example: --- import Logo from '@/components/ui/marketing/Logo/Logo.astro'; --- Acme

cta.name: CTA
cta.description: Closing call-to-action band centered, with logo, heading, description and actions slots (each rendered only when filled).
useInstead: Use Section for ordinary content bands; CTA is the closing conversion block.
cta.example:
--- import CTA from '@/components/ui/marketing/CTA/CTA.astro'; import Button from '@/components/ui/form/Button/Button.astro'; ---

Ready to launch?

Start from a site that is fast, accessible and translated.

npm-copy-button.name: NpmCopyButton
npm-copy-button.description: Button that shows a shell command and copies it to the clipboard, with "copied" feedback.
useInstead: Use CodeBlock for multi-line code.
npm-copy-button.example:
---
import NpmCopyButton from '@/components/ui/marketing/NpmCopyButton/NpmCopyButton.astro';
---

<NpmCopyButton command="npm create velocity-astro@latest" size="md" />

social-proof.name: SocialProof
social-proof.description: Row of overlapping avatar circles (images or placeholders) next to a short trust line.
useInstead: Use AvatarGroup for user lists outside marketing copy.
social-proof.example:
---
import SocialProof from '@/components/ui/marketing/SocialProof/SocialProof.astro';
---

<SocialProof text="Trusted by 2,000+ teams" avatarCount={4} size="md" />

terminal-demo.name: TerminalDemo
terminal-demo.description: React island that animates a terminal replaying the create-velocity-astro CLI prompts. Takes no props.
useInstead: Use CodeBlock for static commands, or NpmCopyButton for a copyable install command.

contact-form.name: ContactForm
contact-form.description: Complete contact form (name, email, subject, message) submitting to the `contact` Astro Action or an external endpoint, with localized labels, validation and status.
useInstead: Use ContactForm instead of building a form from Input/Textarea/Button; the schema lives in src/lib/forms.ts and the handler in src/actions/index.ts.
contact-form.example:
---
import ContactForm from '@/components/patterns/ContactForm.astro';
---

<ContactForm submitLabel="Send message" labels={{ subject: 'Topic' }} />

newsletter-form.name: NewsletterForm
newsletter-form.description: Inline email signup form submitting to the `newsletter` Astro Action or an external endpoint, with localized status messages.

form-field.name: FormField
form-field.description: Label, hint, error and required marker around a custom control passed in the input slot.
useInstead: Input, Textarea, Select, Checkbox and Switch have label/hint/error built in; use FormField only for custom controls.
form-field.example:
---
import FormField from '@/components/patterns/FormField.astro';
---

<FormField label="Favorite color" hint="Pick any color." required>
  <input slot="input" type="color" name="color" class="h-10 w-16 rounded-md border border-border" />
</FormField>

search-input.name: SearchInput
search-input.description: Search field (type="search") built from Input with a leading search icon; used by the Pagefind search page.
search-input.example:
---
import SearchInput from '@/components/patterns/SearchInput.astro';
---

<form action="/search" role="search">
  <SearchInput name="q" placeholder="Search the docs" aria-label="Search" />
</form>

password-input.name: PasswordInput
password-input.description: Password field built from Input with a show/hide toggle button.
password-input.example:
---
import PasswordInput from '@/components/patterns/PasswordInput.astro';
---

<PasswordInput name="password" label="Password" autocomplete="new-password" hint="At least 12 characters." />

stat-card.name: StatCard
stat-card.description: Metric card with label, value, optional icon and an up/down/neutral trend line.
stat-card.example:
---
import StatCard from '@/components/patterns/StatCard.astro';
---

<StatCard label="Monthly visitors" value="48.2k" trend="up" trendText="+12% from last month" icon="users" />

empty-state.name: EmptyState
empty-state.description: Centered placeholder for empty lists or results: icon, title, description and an optional action button or slot.
empty-state.example:
---
import EmptyState from '@/components/patterns/EmptyState.astro';
---

<EmptyState icon="search" title="No results" description="Try a different search term." actionLabel="Clear search" actionHref="/search" />

hero.name: Hero
hero.description: Page-opening hero section, centered or split, with badge, title, description, actions and aside slots plus optional grid and blob backgrounds.
useInstead: Use PageHeader for inner pages; Hero is for landing and home pages. Put the page's <h1> in the title slot.
hero.example:
--- import Hero from '@/components/hero/Hero.astro'; import Badge from '@/components/ui/data-display/Badge/Badge.astro'; import Button from '@/components/ui/form/Button/Button.astro'; --- New

Build faster sites

A production-ready Astro starter.

header.name: Header
header.description: Site header with logo, nav from nav.config.ts, CTA, action buttons, theme toggle, language switcher and mobile menu; bar or floating capsule.
useInstead: Use SiteHeader (src/components/site/SiteHeader.astro), which every layout renders; set defaults there instead of rendering Header from a layout or page.
Change nav items, CTA and actions in src/config/nav.config.ts.
header.example:
---
import Header from '@/components/layout/Header.astro';
---

<!-- In src/components/site/SiteHeader.astro -->
<Header position="fixed" size="lg" shape="floating" showCta {...Astro.props} />

footer.name: Footer
footer.description: Site footer in simple, columns, minimal or stacked layouts, with nav, link groups, social and legal links, tagline and copyright.
useInstead: Use SiteFooter (src/components/site/SiteFooter.astro), which every layout renders; set defaults there instead of rendering Footer from a layout or page.
footerConfig.extraLinks in src/config/nav.config.ts only appears in the simple and stacked layouts.

consent-banner.name: ConsentBanner
consent-banner.description: Cookie consent banner and settings dialog with Google Consent Mode v2; renders only when PUBLIC_CONSENT_ENABLED is true.
useInstead: BaseLayout already renders ConsentBanner; configure categories and copy in src/config/consent.config.ts instead of adding it to pages.
consent-banner.example:
---
import ConsentBanner from '@/components/ui/overlay/ConsentBanner/ConsentBanner.astro';
---

<!-- Already in src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro -->
<ConsentBanner position="bottom" />

google-map.name: GoogleMap
google-map.description: Consent-aware Google Maps embed by coordinates or address; shows a setup prompt without PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY and a placeholder until consent.
useInstead: Use GoogleMap rather than a raw Maps <iframe>, which would load Google before the visitor consents.
google-map.example:
---
import GoogleMap from '@/components/ui/data-display/GoogleMap/GoogleMap.astro';
---

<GoogleMap address="1 Infinite Loop, Cupertino, CA" zoom={14} size="lg" ariaLabel="Map of our office" />

section.name: Section
section.description: Page section with standard spacing and width, an optional eyebrow/title/lead heading block, action slot and tinted tone.
useInstead: Use Section for every content band on a page instead of hand-rolled <section> padding and container classes.
section.example: --- import Section from '@/components/patterns/Section.astro'; import Button from '@/components/ui/form/Button/Button.astro'; ---

page-header.name: PageHeader
page-header.description: Opening band for inner pages with eyebrow, title and lead; holds the page's only <h1>.
useInstead: Use Hero for landing pages. Do not add another <h1> to a page that uses PageHeader.
page-header.example:
---
import PageHeader from '@/components/patterns/PageHeader.astro';
---

<PageHeader eyebrow="Company" title="About us" lead="We build fast, accessible websites." />

media-slot.name: MediaSlot
media-slot.description: Optimized image from src/assets/photos/<photo> at a fixed aspect ratio, or a labelled placeholder until the photo exists.
useInstead: Use MediaSlot for page photos instead of a raw ; drop the file into src/assets/photos/ and it appears.
media-slot.example:
---
import MediaSlot from '@/components/patterns/MediaSlot.astro';
---

<MediaSlot photo="team" alt="Our team outside the office" label="Team photo" ratio="4/3" />
